page.intro: Technical Developer tools: supervision of MFA cleanups and exceptional approval of recoveries. It doesn't grant Admin permissions.

cleanups.intro: Supervision and manual retry. The retry only deletes the factors saved when the role was removed, never new factors.

recoveries.heading: Exceptional recoveries
recoveries.intro: Requests from an administrator who is the only eligible administrator. Approve only if you recognize the request through another channel; you can't decide on your own. If another eligible administrator exists, the request disappears from this list and they approve it.
recoveries.cooldown: You have just become a Developer. For security, you'll be able to approve exceptional recoveries in {remaining}{at}. In the meantime you can review and reject them.
